cards.def:
The process of raising and nurturing children.
हिंदी: पालन-पोषण / परवरिश
examples: Parenting must be loving and firm.

cards.def:
The way a child is raised.
हिंदी: लालन-पालन

Physical, mental, and emotional growth of a child.
हिंदी: बाल विकास

Caring for and encouraging growth.
हिंदी: पोषण करना / संवारना

The deep psychological bond of safety and affection formed between an infant and primary caregiver.
हिंदी: भावनात्मक जुड़ाव
examples: A secure emotional attachment in early infancy lays the foundation for adult mental health.
Attentive parenting fosters a trusting emotional attachment that helps children explore confidently.
Children who lack stable emotional attachment often struggle with interpersonal trust later.
Consistent warmth and responsive comforting strengthen the parent-child emotional attachment.

cards.def:
Forming a close relationship.
हिंदी: आपसी लगाव बनना

The loving physical and emotional care given to promote the growth and well-being of a child.
हिंदी: स्नेहपूर्ण देखभाल
examples: Healthy child development requires a warm blend of structural guidance and tender nurturance.
Grandparents often provide an abundance of unconditional nurturance and comfort.
A home filled with patient nurturance enables children to overcome shyness and anxiety.
Nurturance involves celebrating a child's unique milestones with enthusiasm and love.

cards.def:
Encouraging good behavior with rewards.
हिंदी: सकारात्मक प्रोत्साहन
examples: Positive Reinforcement works better than punishment.

cards.def:
A penalty for wrongdoing.
हिंदी: दंड / सज़ा

Expressing approval.
हिंदी: प्रशंसा

Giving support and confidence.
हिंदी: हौसला-अफ़ज़ाई

An individual's intrinsic sense of value, dignity, and being worthy of love and respect.
हिंदी: आत्म-मूल्य
examples: Unconditional parental acceptance builds a child's lifelong sense of healthy self-worth.
Comparing siblings harshly can severely damage a young child's emerging self-worth.
Teachers build students' self-worth by praising effort, perseverance, and curiosity.
A robust sense of self-worth protects teenagers from succumbing to negative peer pressure.

cards.def:
Belief in oneself.
हिंदी: आत्मविश्वास

An active, eager desire to learn, explore new ideas, and understand how the world works.
हिंदी: बौद्धिक जिज्ञासा
examples: Hands-on science experiments stimulate children's natural intellectual curiosity.
Parents can spark intellectual curiosity by asking open-ended questions about nature.
Visiting libraries and museums nurtures intellectual curiosity from a tender age.
A school curriculum should feed intellectual curiosity rather than enforcing rigid memorization.

cards.def:
Activity for fun and learning.
हिंदी: खेल

Learning through play.
हिंदी: खेल-आधारित शिक्षा

The period from birth to age eight.
हिंदी: प्रारंभिक बाल्यावस्था

Formal learning in early years.
हिंदी: प्रारंभिक बाल शिक्षा
examples: Early Childhood Education must be accessible.

cards.def:
An institution for young children.
हिंदी: प्री-स्कूल / नर्सरी

A class for young children before formal school.
हिंदी: किंडरगार्टन

Being prepared for formal schooling.
हिंदी: स्कूल के लिए तैयारी

The ability to understand, interpret, and apply basic numerical concepts in everyday life.
हिंदी: गणितीय समझ
examples: Early games with counting blocks help toddlers build fundamental mathematical literacy.
Mathematical literacy is essential for managing personal budgets and household expenses.
Schools are modernizing pedagogy to make foundational mathematical literacy enjoyable.
Strong mathematical literacy opens up exciting opportunities in science and computing.

cards.def:
Interpreting written words.
हिंदी: पढ़ना

Telling stories to children.
हिंदी: कहानी सुनाना

Ability to work with numbers.
हिंदी: संख्या-ज्ञान

The act of conveying one's unique ideas, feelings, and imagination through artistic mediums.
हिंदी: रचनात्मक अभिव्यक्ति
examples: Finger painting provides toddlers with an uninhibited outlet for creative expression.
Music and theater classes encourage children to explore joyful creative expression.
Providing art supplies at home gives kids a healthy alternative to screen time for creative expression.
Creative expression helps children articulate complex emotions they cannot yet verbalize.

cards.def:
Growth of thinking and reasoning.
हिंदी: संज्ञानात्मक विकास

Growth of emotional skills.
हिंदी: भावनात्मक विकास

Growth of social skills.
हिंदी: सामाजिक विकास

Growth of right and wrong understanding.
हिंदी: नैतिक विकास

A person children imitate.
हिंदी: आदर्श व्यक्ति

Parents' participation in education.
हिंदी: अभिभावकों की भागीदारी

Time spent together as a family.
हिंदी: परिवार के साथ समय

Exchange of thoughts and feelings.
हिंदी: संवाद / बातचीत

Paying attention to others.
हिंदी: सुनना

The communication and emotional abilities used to interact, cooperate, and resolve conflict with others.
हिंदी: पारस्परिक कौशल
examples: Team sports help children build essential interpersonal skills like cooperation and patience.
Developing good interpersonal skills makes it easier for kids to forge healthy friendships.
Role-playing games teach children conflict resolution and respectful interpersonal skills.
Active listening is the cornerstone of effective interpersonal skills throughout life.

cards.def:
The quality of being kind, tender, calm, and considerate in handling people and situations.
हिंदी: कोमलता
examples: Parents teach toddlers gentleness when interacting with small animals and babies.
A teacher's gentle correction motivates students far more effectively than harsh reprimands.
Speaking with calm gentleness de-escalates toddler tantrums without causing distress.
Gentleness should never be mistaken for weakness; it requires immense inner discipline.

cards.def:
Polite, respectful, and considerate behavior showing good manners toward everyone.
हिंदी: शिष्टता
examples: Saying 'please' and 'thank you' is an early lesson in everyday courteousness for children.
Courteousness creates a harmonious and pleasant atmosphere within the family home.
Demonstrating courteousness toward service workers reflects a child's true upbringing.
Children learn courteousness primarily by observing how their parents treat others.

cards.def:
The habit of being thorough, careful, dependable, and organized in fulfilling one's duties.
हिंदी: कर्तव्यनिष्ठा
examples: Children who develop conscientiousness complete their homework without constant reminders.
Assigned household chores teach young adolescents practical conscientiousness and reliability.
Conscientiousness in organizing schoolbooks saves time and reduces daily morning stress.
Employers rank conscientiousness as one of the most desirable traits in new graduates.

cards.def:
Ability to act on one's own.
हिंदी: आत्मनिर्भरता

Skills for daily living.
हिंदी: जीवन-कौशल
examples: Life Skills include cooking and budgeting.

cards.def:
Understanding money management.
हिंदी: वित्तीय साक्षरता

The knowledge, practices, and precautions necessary to safeguard children from online risks.
हिंदी: साइबर सुरक्षा (ऑनलाइन सुरक्षा)
examples: Parents must educate children about basic cyber safety before giving them smartphones.
Cyber safety rules include never sharing passwords or personal home addresses online.
Schools organize annual cyber safety seminars to alert students to internet scams and predators.
Enabling parental controls is an effective technical safeguard for household cyber safety.

cards.def:
Time spent on digital devices.
हिंदी: स्क्रीन पर बिताया समय

Bullying through digital devices.
हिंदी: साइबर बुलिंग / ऑनलाइन धमकाना

Protecting children from harm.
हिंदी: बाल सुरक्षा

Rights protecting children.
हिंदी: बाल अधिकार

Parenting with warmth and structure.
हिंदी: सकारात्मक पालन-पोषण

Growth of body, mind, and heart.
हिंदी: समग्र विकास
examples: Holistic Development must be the goal.
